text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since the Shuka 
Sho—and the sheer strength Gentildonna 
displayed sent shockwaves through the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More reporters gathered for the press 
conference announcing her next race than 
ever before. Under the intense 
spotlight—she opened her mouth to speak.
choice_data_list:
Next, we will set our sights on the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
No, I see. That makes sense! For an 
Umamusume like Gentildonna, that path was 
an option too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Since her rival Verxina is going to the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup... I just assumed 
she'd be heading there too."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
“Still... has any Umamusume who won the 
Shuka Sho ever gone on to win the Japan 
Cup before?”

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
There isn't. There really isn't, but 
still— You saw that run, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Well then, please tell us your thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My enthusiasm... you say?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This year's Japan Cup has an even 
more formidable lineup of champions than 
usual!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“Holder of the immortal record for the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), Tosen Jordan!”

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The Derby Umamusume from two years ago, 
the proud Eishin Flash!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And—representing Japan to challenge the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, the Triple 
Crown Umamusume, Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
This will be your first showdown against 
the titans of the Senior Class. 
Gentildonna, could you share some of your 
fresh enthusiasm—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho. How strange.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Why does everyone treat me like a 
challenger?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Of course, all the participants are 
wonderful. I have completed my research on 
them as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Everything about those who dare 
“challenge” me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-!? Challenge them, you say... but 
every single one of them is an experienced 
senior, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Experience is power as well. I am well 
aware of that.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"However, I possess the strength to sweep 
even that away."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A-And that power is...! ...Wait, I'm 
getting deja vu—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Riding the wave of an era... I am sure you 
all know how powerful that can be.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you are a Triple Crown Umamusume, 
there will be no escape for you."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Please, come and capture the sight of 
me... taking the victory that is 
rightfully mine. Hohoho..."
choice_data_list:
(Now then, what kind of reaction will I 
get...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with the Tiara Umamusume's 
thoroughly confident attitude, the 
reporters fell into bewildered silence. 
The quiet press conference quickly made 
waves everywhere—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the cheek...! I'm your senpai on the 
racetrack, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Should we show 'em the ropes, as a senior 
duo?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I say that, but it's way too scary, so no 
way.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, it's so frustrating! Right, 
Fla-saaan?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...With that, my break has run over by 
five minutes. I must return to training."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, Flash, doesn't that bother you at 
all?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I run because I think.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In order to gain the strength to cut down 
her pride.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—That concludes Gentildonna's press 
conference.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Did you enjoy it? Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Nothing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Why did you show me this?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry if I upset you. It's just... I 
wanted you to know.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she wants to get a taste of 
your true strength.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Orfe? ...Think you can go 
all out?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for me to exert my full 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Pesky bugs are simply swatted away with 
one's tail. Nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—And this is... the intensive training 
regimen for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's very little time left. A 
meticulously crafted regimen to bring her 
to her absolute peak for the Japan Cup...
choice_data_list:
Well? Blew right past your expectations, 
didn't it?
Well? Did it exceed your expectations?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Ho-ho-ho.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho. Ohohoho...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —That's right.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
With this, allow me to replace it. The 
King's head, that is.

text_block_list.name: Commuter A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see Gentildonna's press 
conference? She was so haughty, it was 
insane~. Well, I guess she's got the 
skills to back it up.

text_block_list.name: Commuter B
text_block_list.text:
“Still, your opponent is Orfevre, right? 
Plus a whole bunch of other Senior-class 
heavyweights! Taking a step back here 
might be best for your future—”

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...That's not true. If someone's 
strong... it's fine for them to stay 
strong, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
If it's Ms. Gentile, I'm sure... she'll 
prove it—
